programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Life in the Sea
programme.desc: Our planet is one of oceans, and it was this great mass of water that gave birth to Earth's greatest creation - life

programme.title: June (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: It's chaos in the Northern hemisphere, our bird feeders are busy as parents work around the clock to raise their young. There's a baby boom, and young foxes, even in our city centres, leave their dens to explore. Its winter in the south though, cold times for guanacos on the slopes of the Andes. And dry times for elephants in Botswana. They migrate north to the life-giving waters of the Chobe River

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Few things make us shiver like the thought of falling prey to one of the world's great predators. With teeth, claws, stings and venom, they inflict death on their prey, and instil fear in us. But who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dan-gerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom, imagining close shaves with all the planet's most dangerous creatures.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: On the doorstep of one of the country's biggest cities, Muaūpoko /Otago Peninsula provides a breeding refuge for birds and marine mammals. Northern royal albatrosses return here every year to raise their chicks at the world's only mainland colony. On sheltered beaches around the Peninsula, once hunted from these shores, New Zealand sea lions are returning to form a breeding colony after an absence of centuries.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: Elephants - Changing Lives
programme.desc: Living for over half a century, elephants see the world change around them as they grow. They say an elephant never forgets; if we could enter the massive brain of a veteran elephant, what would we see? Imagine one elephant to represent them all, giving us a unique glimpse into the remarkable life of these magnificent giants.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Antarctic
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: Destination Wild - India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Where the South Pacific Ocean meets the Tasman Sea, thirteen islands stretch across the blue desert as if a giant has tossed rocks from the sky above, Manawatāwhi/ The Three Kings Islands. Ancient, wild, and remote, this ocean junction bewitches many who visit. Upwellings of cold nutrient rich water support a spectacle of marine life, while a small pod of Bottlenose Dolphins has given up their nomadic ways to make this place their home.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: In the middle of Colombia, lies an ancient, unique and little explored outcrop of sandstone; the Serrania de la Macarena. It forms part of the country's first ever national park - made up of lush jungle, shrubland and savannah, isolated peaks, winding rivers and spectacular waterfalls - where more than 15 million specimens were collected during early studies of the area. Called the 'treasure of the world', scientists believe it is a hugely important bank of biological diversity.

programme.title: Elephants - Changing Lives
programme.desc: Living for over half a century, elephants see the world change around them as they grow. They say an elephant never forgets; if we could enter the massive brain of a veteran elephant, what would we see? Imagine one elephant to represent them all, giving us a unique glimpse into the remarkable life of these magnificent giants.

programme.title: July (Nature's Calendar)
programme.desc: As schools break up for summer and kids can play in meadows amid poppies and singing sky larks, wildlife around the world has very different stories to tell. Lemmings are going crazy. On the Arctic tundra, the ground's frozen for most of the year, now they need to make the most of the time of plenty. But the giving summer heat is too much in southern Spain, where pools are drying out leaving fish high and dry, a feast for herons.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: This episode explores nature's deadliest killers. From a tiny but deadly insect, to a pod of hungry Orca's, predators come in all sizes, and are found on every continent on earth. Chasing, stalking, ambushing or using camouflage, the way each predator hunts, catches and kills food is determined by many factors, including the anatomical adaptations of both the predator and the prey.

programme.title: Icy Coast
programme.desc: Cold coasts create challenging landscapes for all wildlife. It's hard to believe that these freezing oceans can be bringers of life. In fact, cold water holds onto oxygen much better than warm, encouraging aquatic activity. Great eagles hunt abundant marine life in the bleak northern hemisphere whilst cold water corals thrive off the nutrient rich currents passing through their reefs, and massive elephant seals fight for territory off the coast of Australia.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: Nature's Oddballs - Creatures of the Night
programme.desc: hile we sleep comfortably in our beds, one of the most spectacular groups of animals go to work - prepare to meet the creatures of the night!

programme.title: These Birds Are Made For Walking
programme.desc: Few things are more wondrous than the gift of flight, but some birds have chosen to give it up - the question is, why? Whether it's to save energy, tap into new food resources or invest in other skills, they all have their reasons. But one thing's for sure: it doesn't make flightless birds any less weird and wonderful. There are 60 species of bird that have given up the gift of flight, but they are not all related. Each have taken their own evolutionary path.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Aldabra Tortoise, Matriarch Elephants, Kittiwakes, Honey Bees, Hydra, Lions In this episode of Aging in the Wild, we explore the physiological secrets and factors that determine life expectancy in various animal species. From the seventy-year-old elephant to the quasi-immortal hydra, and the more than a hundred-year-old tortoise, we explore life expectancy, longevity and senescence. Can we distinguish between the effects of the environment and the internal adaptations that lead to longevity?

programme.title: World's Wildest City: Anchorage
programme.desc: Anchorage has a rather unique resident who is renowned as nature's lumberjack and North Americas largest rodent, the beaver. With their powerful teeth the trees they fell can be huge and their dams can be so enormous they can be seen from space. But since humans arrived here, many beavers have been forced to live in an urban jungle! And as the Wild City of Anchorage expands, that means more people, more cars, and the biggest risk to the beavers, dogs!

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving - but though always on the move they're not exactly speedy.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: Many animals have evolved chemicals to enhance their chance of survival: some scorpions literally drug their potential mates, others use their poisons to defend or kill. The world of venoms and poisons, the apparatus designed to deliver the payload and the strategies that animals employ to use them most effectively is a rich and varied example of natural selection and evolution in action.

programme.title: Aquarium: An Aquatic Life
programme.desc: Join us as we delve into the inner workings of the Two Oceans Aquarium and meet the team who keep the machine running! Learn how they cater for hundreds of different dietary requirements, how they keep up with the demand of life-giving water and meet the new arrivals to the aquarium; from the six-legged spider crabs of Japan, to the tiny turtles in need of rehabilitation. We'll move behind the glass to reveal the secrets of Africa's premier Aquarium!

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: In nature, competition for territory is so extreme that some animals have resorted to living in incredible hostile conditions. From brutal cold, to extreme heat, from the ocean depths, to the driest of deserts, this episode showcases some incredible survival stories in the world's most inhospitable environments.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Deep in the Southern Ocean, the Snares islands are one of the most pristine island wildernesses left on the planet. Every summer, millions of seabirds converge here to breed. More than 50,000 endemic Snares crested penguins battle massive Southern Ocean swells to come ashore. Deep in the forest they find their mates and raise their chicks in a frantic race to take advantage of the short subantarctic summer.

programme.title: History of Life on Earth - Life in the Sea
programme.desc: Our planet is one of oceans, and it was this great mass of water that gave birth to Earth's greatest creation - life

programme.title: World of the Wild
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: Wildest Places: Antarctic
programme.desc: Wildest Places explores some of the most incredible natural habitats on earth & a diverse range of wildlife.

programme.title: Wild Indochinas - Wild heart
programme.desc: Indochina; three ancient kingdoms, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia, linked by one great river: the mighty Mekong. A mystical land shaped by the forces of the monsoon. A region ravaged by war but, like a Phoenix, risen from the ashes. Within its boundaries can be found one tenth of the world's species, and some of the richest ecosystems on the planet. This is the land of the Mother River, one of the most bio diverse regions on Earth.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: The culture of Japan is incredible. But there are also more than 130 mammals and 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands.

programme.title: Aging in the Wild
programme.desc: Salmon, Bears, Beluga Whales, Naked Mole Rat, Bacteria, Aspen Trees In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer.

programme.title: Rhino Orphanage
programme.desc: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage. She's not the only newby as Nox the bushbaby, and new volunteers are around to keep her company.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde tries to illuminate the subject of trophy hunting from all sides. She talks to the Khwe chief, villagers and game guards in the Zambezi region. She meets a trophy hunter and follows the topic back to Germany, where she exchanges ideas with Izak Smit, the Chairperson of Desert Lions Human Relations Aid, Delhra in short.
programme.sub-title: Trophy hunting - just killing or conservation?

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise

programme.title: Hidden UK
programme.desc: For its tiny size the UK is a hugely varied landscape with a surprising collection of remarkable and awe-inspiring wildlife.

programme.title: Hawaii: Paradise in the Pacific
programme.desc: In epsiode one we take a look at Kaua'i - the oldest island in the archipelago. Kaua'i's isolation for thousands of years led to an increased rate of evolution. In a relatively short time, new species are formed here, many animals and plants can only be found here. But they are in danger. On the shield volcano Waiʻaleʻale - the rainiest place on earth, scientists like Lukas Behnke are fighting for the preservation of endangered native animals and plants.

programme.title: Wildest Survival
programme.desc: For every baby animal born, billions don't make it. Drought, flood, famine and predation; babies are born into a harsh world. The odds are so heavily stacked against some animals that it's a miracle any of their youngsters survive at-all. In this episode we discover the incredible lengths that nature's parents go to in order to ensure their progeny's survival.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: It's a miracle the first seafarers ever found the Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani scattered across two million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean. But every year, these tropical islands become the destination for over three thousand Humpback whales who've undertaken one of the longest migrations on the planet. They come here to socialise, mate, and raise their young.

programme.title: Nature's Cutest
programme.desc: As we all know the natural world can be tough and challenging at times, but it can also be nothing short of adorable. Fluffy white seals, wobbly-kneed fawns, playing polar bear cubs, adorable teddy bear-like koalas - so much cute it would be impossible to decide which was the most adorable. But why do we consider some animals cute and others not? What it is about them that makes us fall in love? Perhaps it's those animals that remind us of ourselves?

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Wild Wolverine
programme.desc: To many the wolverine is the stuff of movie superheroes. To others they are a creature of myth and legend. They look like a weird hybrid between wolf, bear and skunk and are some of the toughest, strongest and most aggressive animals around. In the sub-arctic forests of Siberia survival is an expert skill. The creatures of the far north strike a delicate balance and must show ingenuity and cunning if they are to survive.

programme.title: Animals of the Bible
programme.desc: The bible is one of the most famous texts on earth. But it doesn't just concern humans, it also mentions animals - and some of these are probably not what you'd expect. We've all heard of the ox and the ass, the donkey that carried Mary, but did you know gazelles are mentioned in the bible? Or that great whales, cunning leopards and even the energetic hyrax feature?

programme.title: Wildest Islands
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: Secret Life of Baby Owls
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Marine Mammals - Born to Swim
programme.desc: Every year some 15 million of us around the world cram onto little boats and head out onto the ocean, hoping for the encounter of a lifetime. For centuries whales and dolphins seem to have reached out to us, capturing our imaginations and our souls. Despite their popularity, much of their lives remain a mystery, taking place beneath the waves and beyond our reach.

programme.desc: Several US presidents throughout history have described encounters with UAPs. Is there already an agreement in place between our world leaders and intelligent alien life? And if so, who is keeping that information from the public and why?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight? And in 2017 scientists discovered another mysterious satellite from outside our solar system. What could explain Oumuamua's artificial trajectory?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The Soviet Union's vast skies paid witness to thousands of UFO sightings. But the Soviet regime was notorious for secrecy. Many of their encounters reported during the Cold War had potentially deadly consequences for the entire world.

programme.title: UFO Casebook
programme.desc: Of all the various kinds of UFO related phenomenon that has materialized, the so called light spheres certainly hold a particularly important place. These objects have recently gained great popularity thanks in part to the studies conducted by Dr. Eltjo Haselhoff, who believes that these light spheres could be the cause behind crop circles. The lights began to appear many years ago...but why?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: More than half the world's UFO sightings happen over water. Many of these phenomena are seen bursting from the ocean into the sky. Do aliens lurk in our oceans? Join us as we expose the growing threat of Unidentified Submerged Objects.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: In the 1960s we took our first steps into a vast new realm-bound for the Moon. But NASA astronauts would soon find they weren't the only ones out there.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Scientists have never been closer to proving that life once lived on Mars. But is it still there? And if so, how has it evolved? Join us as we investigate the red planet and the possibility that alien life may live within our own galaxy.

programme.title: UFO Diaries
programme.desc: 1492: Christopher Columbus, close to discovering a new world, affirmed to watch with his crew a weird flying object in the zone that centuries later should be called The Bermuda Triangle. In 1945, the Flight 19 of the Ft. Lauderdale Naval Air Station in Florida disappeared while they practiced. Located between Miami, Cuba and the Bermuda Islands, the Bermuda Triangle is a place of mystery.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Many UFO sightings are solitary events that leave witnesses scrambling to prove their story. But what happens when the same object is seen by many people at the same time? Join us as we expose the hidden secrets of The Kecksburg Incident.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: What does the American government really know about UFO's? And how far will they go to hide the truth? In 1948 a fireball crashes near Laredo, Texas. They say it was an experimental aircraft. But many experts believe it was a UFO.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The Soviet Union's vast skies paid witness to thousands of UFO sightings. But the Soviet regime was notorious for secrecy. Many of their encounters reported during the Cold War had potentially deadly consequences for the entire world.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Encountering life from another world can be a terrifying and deadly experience. Abductees claim to have been captured and experimented on. Join us as we confront the truth about alien encounters.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Everyday, UFOs are spotted in skies all over the world. But of all the planets in the known galaxy, why have they come to Earth? Are aliens here to seize Earth's riches? And how far does their mission go?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Close encounters. There's no telling where or when they will happen. But of all the possible scenarios, none is more terrifying than the one we're unaware of - until it's too late.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: What could be haunting an abandoned theme park in Lancashire? Ghost Dimension seek out paranormal activity in Camelot and they are in for a ride!

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Bex and Sean explore Gwrych Castle in Wales, renowned for its hauntings. Amid eerie voices, strange noises, and shadows, they use specialized equipment to unveil the spectral mysteries lurking within. Will they unearth Gwrych Castle's ghostly secrets?

programme.title: The Past Hunters: Enter the Paranormal
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking classes.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: This episode explores the paranormal mysteries surrounding an August 2000 Briton sighting, where police crossed paths with a strange light in the sky.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: On December 28, 1980, the Rendlesham Incident became a legendary mystery, as US Air Force soldiers recorded witness accounts of mysterious lights appearing in the skies of Suffolk, England.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: For decades, Kent's Blue Bell Hill has been the site of mysterious phenomena. Rumored ghost sightings have haunted the pastoral site. Explore the haunting legacy of Blue Bell Hill in this episode.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Blue Bell Hill

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: In 1995, a small UK village was disrupted by a brutal fire that destroyed its town hall. To this day, no culprit has emerged - were otherworldly forces responsible?

programme.title: Dark Clouds Over Elberton: The True Story of the Georgia Guidestones
programme.desc: In 1979, a mysterious stranger appeared in the remote town of Elberton, Georgia. The man introduced himself as R.C. Christian, but admitted it was not his real name. Researchers have wondered for decades about his real identity and the purpose of a monument which he claimed would inspire 'the Age of Reason.' After a 5 year investigation, this powerful documentary dares to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: The Old Picture House in Nottingham in the UK, was a cinema abandoned in 1959. Today it houses a museum of haunted artefacts. Steve and Marie have captured what they believe to be paranormal activity on a hearse dating back to the Victorian era. Intrigued by the findings, we have sent MJ Dickson to investigate and validate their claims.

programme.title: Paranormal Captured
programme.desc: Unusual activity has been captured on CCTV at an antique centre in Barnsley, UK. It is suspected that a poltergeist may be the culprit. In search of the truth, paranormal investigator Jayne Harris has been despatched to see if she can gather proof for sceptical shop owner Daniel. And in the Paranormal Captured headquarters, footage and stories from around the world are analysed by our experts.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard delves into claims that the medical profession, drug companies, food industry, government agencies and other vested interests are conspiring to suppress multiple proven cancer cures.
programme.sub-title: Is the Cure for Cancer Being Suppressed?

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us

Some, like Próspera Muñoz, who gave us in her last interview, possibly the most credible abduction account in our story, return to tell what happened. She is not the only one, as we will see in this exciting chapter.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: In Dec 1995-Mar 1996, a surge of UFO sightings occurred, notably at Polvorin of As Gándaras, Lugo. Military witnessed triangle lights on infrared cameras, marking our longest and most prolific UFO event. Cases included landings and encounters with mysterious lights and alleged crews. A year prior, 'something' crashed from space in Cando de Arriba mountains, A Coruña, igniting the phenomenon.
programme.sub-title: UFOs in Spain - The Last Great Wave

programme.desc: Immersed in Ireland's timeless beauty is a dark history of magic, ritual and prime evil worship. Elemental forces from this ancient past come back as apparitions to wander amongst the living and many of these restless souls are trapped in Ireland's castles. The spirits reach out from the beyond, lost phantoms that have become the castle ghosts of Ireland.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: Newlyweds Bill and Myrisa Spencer move into a renovated apartment, eager for a fresh start. But ghostly figures soon roam the halls, and their dream home turns into a nightmare. Unable to break their lease, they endure the hauntings-until a violent attack on Bill forces them to seek help. With local ghost hunters, they uncover the building's dark past and the entities that still linger.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The team head to Elland to investigate ghostly goings on in this haunted pub. Its not just the spirits behind the bar lurking here. Multiple hauntings, murders and death surround this public house. Will headless horses make an appearance tonight and who or what haunts the beer cellar?
programme.sub-title: Last Orders at The Fleece Inn

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: This abandoned World War Two air raid shelter holds paranormal secrets that haunt anyone that ventures inside. A menacing ghostly entity makes contact as the team try to uncover the reasons behind the hauntings.

programme.title: The Past Hunters: Enter the Paranormal
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: A Haunting
programme.desc: A Halloween dare leads high school friends Nick, Krystian, and Jon to an old cemetery in Green Lake, Wisconsin. Seeking a rumored haunted mausoleum, they become separated in the darkness. As they sense an eerie presence stalking them, their skepticism turns to terror. They must escape before the vengeful spirits of the graveyard awaken-and ensure they never leave.

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: On the night of Christmas 1998, a homeless man entered the infamous Greyfriars Kirkyard in Edinburgh. Seeking refuge, he broke into the tomb of George Mackenzie - Edinburgh's famous executioner - then fell into an assembly of decomposing corpses. His screams were heard above ground, but something else had been disturbed. Within weeks, stories of blackouts and inexplicable attacks began to spread.

programme.title: The Past Hunters: Enter the Paranormal
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Bex and Sean explore Gwrych Castle in Wales, renowned for its hauntings. Amid eerie voices, strange noises, and shadows, they use specialized equipment to unveil the spectral mysteries lurking within. Will they unearth Gwrych Castle's ghostly secrets?

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: When Andrea Perron moved into her new home in Rhode Island with her parents and four sisters, the previous occupants seemed in a hurry to leave. 'For the sake of your family, leave the lights on in this house at night,' they told her father, Roger. Soon the Perrons were experiencing multiple disturbances, hearing whispers and seeing visions.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown
programme.desc: Bex and Sean investigate Chillingham Castle, the most haunted castle in the world, for a Halloween investigation.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The team head to Lydiate Abbey to investigate claims of a ghostly white lady and stumble upon a totally hidden gem deep in the woods, which has its own spirits haunting. With hidden priest holes and a building being reclaimed by the land. Be prepared for one of the scariest investigations ever.

programme.title: Historic Hauntings
programme.desc: Scotland is a land that has witnessed a bloody history of intrigue and betrayal. The victims of cruel torture and untimely death have become restless spirits doomed to linger in its haunted castles. Cursing the generations that follow their suffering echos down the years.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo
programme.desc: Sean continues his investigation of the castle and attempts to make contact with the spirit world. It appears he is not alone on his investigation.
programme.sub-title: Historic Hauntings of Whittington Castle - Part 2

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: The most famous serial killer in history, the man who murdered five women on the streets of Whitechapel - and got away with it.

programme.title: Mind Investigators
programme.desc: More than a year after the death of Harmonie Marin, her boyfriend is arrested and accused of her murder.

programme.title: The Interrogation Room Hosted by Vivica A. Fox
programme.desc: This episode examines the notorious "Antifreeze Murders" that took place in 2012. Diane and Rachel Staudte murdered two members of their family and attempted to kill a third before police got involved.

programme.title: Crimes Uncovered
programme.desc: The story of Cezanne Visser, her partner Dirk Prinsloo and how they callously broke the law and left a trail of broken lives in their wake.
programme.sub-title: Sordid Lies: The Cezanne Visser Story

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Secret Language of Serial Killers
programme.desc: Explore the most common characteristic among serial killers: the need to tell authorities and the public how powerful they are by controlling life and death.

programme.title: Caught on Bodycam
programme.desc: Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.

programme.title: Caught on Bodycam
programme.desc: Raw bodycam footage capturing high-stake police incidents.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Megan Haines nursed patients at St Andrews Village Nursing Home where she also nursed a lethal grudge. Complaints had been made about the rudeness she'd shown towards patients. Her retaliation? She killed two elderly residents and tried to kill a third. The daughter of one victim, Charli Darragh, gives an emotional interview about the moment she discovered her mother had been murdered.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Efren Saldivar confessed to killing 40 to 50 patients over an eight-year period. Quickly christened an "Angel of Death," he targeted patients who were already near death. Statistical analysis indicates that the total number of murders committed by Saldivar could be as high as 200, but the bodies were cremated after death long before he owned up to his deeds on the wards.

programme.title: Under Arrest
programme.desc: Suspect high on drugs is subdued with a taser, police attend a call of shots fired and a stolen vehicle is chased.
programme.sub-title: You're Going to Get a Headache

programme.title: Under Arrest
programme.desc: Police respond to a break-and-enter in progress, a suspect threatens to kill neighbors and a limo driver is assaulted.

programme.title: Crimes That Made History
programme.desc: On 8 July 1947, the US Air Force announced the discovery of a "flying disc" which had crashed in the Roswell area of New Mexico. This was the birth of the flying saucer phenomenon. Against the backdrop of the Cold War, when conspiracy theories abounded, the myth of the UFO gradually took shape to become a recurrent theme in science-fiction movies and popular culture.

programme.title: Crimes That Made History
programme.desc: On October 1972, an Uruguayan plane crashed into the Andes. 72 days later, 16 survivors are found! The incredible rescue fascinated the media across the world. How did they survive? An unspeakable truth gradually emerges: to survive, the survivors ate their dead comrades' bodies.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: When a young man is murdered in his home, the only suspect with a motive is his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: When an aspiring actress is found dead in the home of a legendary music producer, he claims it was suicide.
programme.sub-title: Phil Spector, Number One With a Bullet

programme.title: Deadly Standoffs
programme.desc: Taking viewers to the front lines of America's most deadly and infamous sieges, delving into the stories behind some of the most devastating standoffs in recent US history.

programme.title: Forensics
programme.desc: A man is running down the road, his face is bloodied and his feet and chest are bare. What has happened, and what is this young man running from?

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives hosted by Nancy Grace
programme.desc: In 1979, 16-year-old Kim Bryant disappears from outside a Dairy Queen in Las Vegas. Three weeks later, her body is found: she had been sexually assaulted and bludgeoned to death. 40 years later, genetic genealogy finally names the killer.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars
programme.desc: This episode features a woman who persuaded her lover to murder her husband, and a mentally challenged man who was tortured and then killed by a woman.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: On a Texas highway, a fire is discovered having burnt three bodies beyond recognition.

programme.title: Gangsters: America's Most Evil
programme.desc: Bey is known as the Philly Intimidator, and he was a key player in the Kaboni Savage Organization.

programme.title: Wardens
programme.desc: Part 2 of a night time patrol to stop anglers from keeping fish that are foul-hooked.

programme.title: Casualty 24/7
programme.desc: It's another busy shift at Barnsley Hospital's casualty department. On today's shift, Sister Jane is managing the ambulance cubicle - where paramedics bring patients for assessment.

programme.title: True Crime Nation with Chris Hansen
programme.desc: Host Chris Hansen and our talented team of veteran crime producers bring you a closer look at the crimes affecting our nation.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Cult of Personality

programme.sub-title: To Catch a Serial Killer - The Green River Killer and BTK

programme.title: Crime Time Solvers
programme.desc: In Valenciennes, the vanishing of Marianne Listoir triggered a desperate race against time.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A woman pleads self-defense in the stabbing death of her allegedly abusive husband.

programme.title: Crimes of Passion
programme.desc: A financier lives after his socialite wife shoots him six times in their Calgary condo.

programme.title: Court Martial: Soldiers Behind Bars

programme.title: Murder Maps
programme.desc: An examination of the notorious crimes of Jack the Ripper, among the most infamous serial killer in history, who murdered five women in Whitechapel, England.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files
programme.desc: Hyams posed as a leading scientist and millionaire art buyer before fleeing to California where he posed as a leading academic.

programme.title: The Interrogation Room Hosted by Vivica A. Fox
programme.desc: Vivica examines the case of double-murderer Cheyanne Jessie. On August 1, 2015, police received a call from Cheyanne Jessie in which she claimed her father Mark Weekly and daughter Meredith were missing.

programme.title: Crimes Uncovered
programme.desc: Seven year-old Sheldean Human disappeared without a trace from her neighbourhood park, leading her community into a frenzied search for her.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: Secret Language of Serial Killers
programme.desc: Discover how killers like Williamn Hearns and Ted Kaczynski use their crime scenes as a form of self-expression, and how profilers and investigators piece together the clues left at these gruesome art exhibits to solve the case.

programme.title: The Real Manhunter
programme.desc: Levi Bellfield is one of the most notorious serial killers in modern British history, most famously committing the brutal murders of Milly Dowler, Marsha McDonnell, and Amelie Delagrange.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Donald Harvey escaped justice for 20 years as he murdered his patients in any way he could. In an exclusive interview, the man who brought him to justice details just how evil Nurse Harvey was. The true extent of his crimes may never be known since so many were undetected for so long.He claims to have killed 87 patients, but official estimates suggest the figure us nearer 60.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill
programme.desc: Gary Davis told his Facebook friends that 'I hate old people' and days before two patients in his care were found dead, he predicted they would die. Those facts were enough to put him in the frame as a doctor became convinced that foul play was responsible for their. Rob Kaplan, a Forensic Psychiatrist from a Sydney University offers a unique insight into health serial-killers.

programme.title: Under Arrest
programme.desc: A high-speed pursuit of a stolen vehicle takes place, a dispute with a neighbor gets out of control, a bar closing results in multiple arrests.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 18-year-old Laetitia Perrais is a trainee hotel waitress who vanishes after an evening shift; every attempt is made to shed light on her disappearance and the efforts eventually pay off.

programme.title: US Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: Big Bad Bounty Hunter Fred tries to keep his look going by jumping the tall fence too!

programme.title: Deadly Standoffs
programme.desc: Taking viewers to the front lines of America's most deadly and infamous sieges, delving into the stories behind some of the most devastating standoffs in recent US history.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Every cook dreams of a perfectly roasted chicken, and today Lidia shows the viewer how to do just that. She starts with an American favorite - a crunchy, cheese Caesar Salad. Her Lemon Roasted Chicken goes beyond comfort food with onions, rosemary and lots of lemons. Finally she prepares a free form Crostata with Juicy Plums.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There are few things better than a great piece of meat braised in Barolo wine. When accompanied by some braised vegetables, you've got yourself a great meal. In this episode, Lidia prepares a crispy golden Italian Style Quiche followed by a fork tender Beef Braised in Barolo. Her side dish is a Braised Broccoli Rabe with garlic and extra virgin olive oil. This is a meal any family will love.

programme.title: The History Of Food

programme.title: How To Cook Well With Rory O'Connell
programme.desc: Moroccan harrira soup. Roast haddock with roast pepper, olive and basil salsa. Mashed potatoes with courgette, olive oil and marjoram. Romanesco. Chocolate, prune and armagnac puddings with chocolate sauce.

programme.title: How To Cook Well With Rory O'Connell
programme.desc: Rory prepares tuna sashimi with crisped radishes and spring onion for this week's starter. Rory completes the meal with a delicious jasmine tea and lemon parfait with tea-soaked prunes and marigold.

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs

programme.title: MORE One Big Recipe

programme.title: Tastes Like Home

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jonny and new boy Ben Collins - the driver who used to be The Stig perform a two wheel driving stunt, Vicki Butler-Henderson puts the radical new four door Mini Countryman through its paces, Tiff Needell races two fast but green coupes head to head.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson blast through the Pyrenees in the brand new BMW M5, Jonny Smith heads to Barcelona to drive SEAT's unbelievably cheap new city car.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson is joined by Norwegian rally prodigy Andreas Mikkelsen for a high octane motoring triathlon - race in a 200bhp off road buggy, perform an autotest in a Skoda Fabia hot hatch, and battle wheel to wheel in single seat race cars.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: In this episode of Fifth Gear Tiff Needell visits northern Sweden for a very chilly rally challenge. He has just a few hours to learn the skills of racing on sheet ice before he takes on a rally champion over a treacherous rally stage.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jonny Smith is in France, experiencing the action packed world of Rallycross; a cross between rallying and circuit racing, where 650bhp machines battle door to door.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason Plato gets behind the wheel of his favourite Porsches and puts them up against some iconic competition

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Jason drives Porsche's newest, rawest car, the 911 GT3 RS. Jonny finds out if the brand-new, high-tech Audi A8 is good enough to keep the big saloon market alive. Vicki looks at Mercedes new luxury drop top, the E-Class Cabriolet.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Tom Ford drives Volvo's stylish new coupe, the C30; and Tiff Needell tests whether a green supercar really can be fun in Lotus' bio-fuel powered Exige 265E.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Fifth Gear reconstructs one of the fastest-growing types of car crash in Britain; a terror that could turn a pleasant motorway journey into one of the most frightening rides of your life.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki tests two cars that are low, light and very fast - Lotus Exige S v Caterham CSR. Tom visits Spain to drive the Toyota Landcruiser. Jason Plato drives the Mercedes CLK63 Black. Tiff teaches Heston Blumenthal the art of powersliding.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson is finding out if progress has been made by Mitsubishi, as she races a classic Evo 6 against the very latest Evo 9.

programme.title: Fifth Gear

programme.title: Fifth Gear

programme.title: Fifth Gear

programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out exactly how well built a Mercedes is when she crashes it, drowns it in a flood and then drives over it in a monster truck.

programme.title: Fifth Gear
programme.desc: Vicki Butler-Henderson attempts to drive flat out in Aston Martin's new Vanquish S. The 520bhp, £175,000-plus super-coupe accelerates from 0-60 in 4.8 seconds and is capable of over 200mph.

programme.desc: Where are your children safest - in a 4x4 or an MPV? Fifth Gear finds out with a spectacular 'worlds first' crash test between a Landrover Discovery and Renault Espace.

programme.desc: Jason pits two diesel coupes against each other. Jonny braves the freezing weather to show off three cabriolets, with a budget of just £5,000. Tom puts the Ford Fiesta against the Seat Ibiza in three tests. Tiff drives the Lamborghini Gallardo

45365 explores the congruities of daily life in an American town. From the patrol car to the courtroom, the playground to the nursing home, the parade to the prayer service, it explores relationships and interactions - with people and their environment. Directed by Turner Ross and Bill Ross IV.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Nicola is a natural winemaker living in a remote village near Crotone, where his atavistic pursuit of wine is under active siege from climate related wildfires and the prolonged dry seasons. For Nicola, and other winemakers like him, this environmental change has existential consequences; it threatens his livelihood. "Wildfire" patiently observes Nicola in this affective state of anxiety-as the wildfire grows within him-as he's forced to alter the course of his harvest in real time.

He is the longest serving non-violent offender in the history of Michigan and he is finally up for clemency. Directed by Kyle Thrash and Haley Elizabeth Anderson. A DOCUMENTARY+ Original.

programme.title: We Are Oscar Mike
programme.desc: Through his non-profit foundation, Oscar Mike, Noah helps rehabilitate other veterans through the adaptive sports that saved his own life. Directed by Nick Cavalier.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Nicola is a natural winemaker living in a remote village near Crotone, where his atavistic pursuit of wine is under active siege from climate related wildfires and the prolonged dry seasons. For Nicola, and other winemakers like him, this environmental change has existential consequences; it threatens his livelihood. "Wildfire" patiently observes Nicola in this affective state of anxiety-as the wildfire grows within him-as he's forced to alter the course of his harvest in real time.

programme.title: In My Own Words: Little Big
programme.desc: DOCUMENTARY+ invited Ilya Prusikin to share their personal story. Ilya is a musician, songwriter, and lead vocalist of the Russian pop-rave superband, Little Big. Ilya recounts the on the ground events of February 24th, the day Russia invaded Ukraine, the group's journey to seek political asylum in the United States, and navigating being labeled a traitor by the Russian government for being outspoken against the war. Directed by Yasir Masood.

programme.title: Salam Neighbor
programme.desc: Two filmmakers fully embed themselves in a Syrian refugee camp, providing an intimate look at the world's most dire humanitarian crisis. Directed by Chris Temple and Zach Ingrasci.

programme.title: Murderous Minds: Dennis Nilsen
programme.desc: Dennis Andrew Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophile who murdered at least twelve young men and boys between 1978 and 1983 in London. Directed by Remone Jones.

45365 explores the congruities of daily life in an American town. From the patrol car to the courtroom, the playground to the nursing home, the parade to the prayer service, it explores relationships and interactions - with people and their environment. The stories of a father and son, a young relationship, cops and criminals, officials and their electorate coalesce into a mosaic of faces, places, and events. 45365 is a portrait of a city and its people. Directed by Turner Ross and Bill Ross IV.

In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Boat Trip
programme.desc: After Nick (Horatio Sanz) makes an insensitive remark, his travel agent decides to get some payback by sending him and his best friend, Jerry (Cuba Gooding Jr.), on a cruise for gay men. As the true nature of their situation gradually dawns on them, they start to get over their feelings of homophobia and meet potential mates. For Nick, love takes the form of a gorgeous model, Inga (Victoria Silvstedt), while Jerry develops feelings for dance instructor Gabriella (Roselyn Sánchez).

programme.desc: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.title: Big Sky

Soon, Meg befriends coworkers Raychel (Mariah Carey) and Kate (Melora Walters) and begins to start a new life. But, after Meg discovers that Santalino's is a mob front, she finds herself deep in danger, and is recruited by the police to spy on her criminally connected boss.

programme.title: Unfightable
programme.desc: Alana McLaughlin is a transgender woman beginning her career in the mixed martial arts. She'll have to contend with athletes who refuse to fight her, find a gym willing to train her, and win a battle against her own personal demons.

programme.title: I Don't Know How She Does It
programme.desc: As an employee at a Boston-based financial firm, Kate Reddy (Sarah Jessica Parker) struggles daily to balance the demands of her high-powered career with the needs of her husband (Greg Kinnear) and children. When she gets an account that requires frequent trips to New York and her husband gets a new job, Kate finds herself spread even thinner. Complicating Kate's life even more is new business associate Jack Abelhammer (Pierce Brosnan), who throws temptation into the mix.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: But I'm a Cheerleader
programme.desc: Megan (Natasha Lyonne) considers herself a typical American girl. She excels in school and cheerleading, and she has a handsome football-playing boyfriend, even though she isn't that crazy about him. So she's stunned when her parents decide she's gay and send her to True Directions, a boot camp meant to alter her sexual orientation. While there, Megan meets a rebellious and unashamed teen lesbian, Graham (Clea DuVall). Though Megan still feels confused, she starts to have feelings for Graham.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: After a comet disrupts the rain cycle of Earth, the planet has become a desolate, barren desert by the year 2033. With resources scarce, Kesslee (Malcolm McDowell) -- head of the powerful and evil Water & Power Corporation, the de facto government -- has taken control of the water supply. Unwilling to cower under Kesslee's tyrannical rule, a pair of outlaws known as Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and Jet Girl (Naomi Watts) rise up, joining the mysterious rebel Rippers to destroy the corrupt system.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

When Owen watches a Hitchcock classic that seems to mirror his own life, he decides to put the movie's plot into action and offers to kill Margaret, if Larry promises to murder his mom. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.

programme.title: Jeremiah
programme.desc: Jeremiah tells the story of the prophet who abandons his family and the woman he loves in order to relay God's message in Jerusalem. Although he is persecuted and branded as a traitor for warning others of the destruction of the Holy City, he continues fearlessly with his mission. When his prophecy is fulfilled, he experiences first-hand Jerusalem's destruction by the Babylonians.

programme.title: Return to the Hiding Place
programme.desc: When the Nazis begin killing Jews in Holland, a group of youth fight to save the lives of the innocent.

programme.title: The Hiding Place
programme.desc: The heroic true story of a family in Holland that hides Jews and fights the Nazi madness with the only weapon they have. Love. Golden Globe nominated.

programme.title: Discovering the Bible
programme.desc: It's the all-time best-seller since the beginning of printing. It has produced passionate controversy for centuries. What is the book that is like none other in the history of the world?

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: Can it be true? Does a giant wooden ark lie beneath ice on the crumbling north slope of Mount Ararat? An ark that has been seen and reported by dozens of reliable witnesses. What about the alleged missing photos of the ark? Truth or fiction? Decide for yourself, but not before you share the remarkable adventures of Ararat's explorers - documented in this episode.

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: John, part of Jesus' inner circle, was exiled on the Greek island of Patmos where tradition believes he wrote the Book of Revelation. We chart his life and career and assess his contemporary impact through the literature named after him.

programme.title: The Twelve Apostles: The First 12 Men Chosen By Jesus
programme.desc: James, a Galilean fisherman, was the first apostle to be martyred. His influence and legacy live on today in the pilgrim journey through the exquisite landscape of Northern Spain to Santiago de Compostela where his relics are kept.

programme.title: Augustine: A Voice For All Generations
programme.desc: Explore the conversion story of one of the most significant figures in church history and learn about his struggle to find answers amid a sea of competing voices. Travel to fourth-century Rome and Milan to discover why Augustine has become a 'Voice for All Generations.'

programme.title: John Bunyan: The Peoples Pilgrim
programme.desc: This documentary reveals the story of John Bunyan's life, his personal struggles, his triumphs, and his remarkable legacy.

programme.title: The Apocalypse
programme.desc: How has a tiny Jewish sect that was turned toward Israel and living in the expectation of the End of Time become the religion of the West? Why does the phrase Alfred Loisy wrote a century ago, 'Jesus announced the Kingdom and was the Church that came,' still create uproar? Why is it that the Jewish origin of Christianity is still unacceptable to many?

programme.title: The Apocalypse
programme.desc: Was Constantine truly a Christian? Why does he keep a close watch over internal Church affairs? Why does Constantine order the Council of Nicaea to be held? Who attends the Council? What issues are debated? Is there a divine hierarchy between the Father and the Son? How was this theological problem solved? Are echoes of Nicaea still perceptible today?

programme.title: Discovering the Bible
programme.desc: The New Testament. It's a book that centers on Jesus. But how do we know we have the actual words of Jesus? How were the books of the New Testament gathered and selected?

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: The Bible is the most widely read book in the history of the world. But does anyone know who really wrote it? What are the facts behind this immortal manuscript? New scientific research and theological insight may provide new clues. What can the Dead Sea Scrolls tell us about the origins of the Bible? Discover how modern technology may finally unravel this age-old mystery.

programme.title: Solomon
programme.desc: Solomon is crowned King of Israel and rules the land with love, peace and respect. While visiting the city, Solomon meets the beautiful Queen of Sheba and falls in love. When she returns to her homeland, Solomon falls into a deep depression, departing from his once idyllic world of peace and luxury while his kingdom threatens to collapse.

programme.title: The Shroud: Face to Face
programme.desc: Robert Orlando's documentary portrays Jesus' crucifixion as a transformative true crime story. It uses New Testament insights, expert interviews, and digital recreations to examine the Shroud of Turin. Bloodstains align with gospel accounts, suggesting authenticity. Orlando hopes to renew interest in Christian history.

programme.title: Home for Christmas
programme.desc: Images, Music, and Memories of the Holidays. 17 Christmas Classics. The whole family will enjoy listening or singing along to instrumental versions of these all-time favorite Christmas songs. Songs Include: Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas, Driving Home For Christmas, Sleigh Ride, White Christmas and more!

programme.title: 25 Messianic Signs Of Christ's Return
programme.desc: In the ancient ages, the Hebrew prophets predicted that before the advent of their promised Messiah, there would come specific signs that would signal the end of the age. Today those signs have become crystal clear. Join prophetic scholar Dr. Noah Hutchings and Ken Klein as they take you on a prophetic tour of the Holy Land, explaining 25 Messianic signs that point to the return of Christ.

programme.title: Ancient Secrets of the Bible
programme.desc: The story of Adam and Eve in the book of Genesis is the most controversial story in the Bible. Was mankind born in the Garden of Eden? The evidence may shock you.
programme.sub-title: Biblical Adam and Eve: Fact or Fiction?

programme.title: Christmas Grace
programme.desc: The story of two rival toy store owners during Christmas time. Gary, who runs an honest business and has a good relationship with his customers and has everything is running smoothly until he hears of a new bigger store.

programme.title: Reflections on Lord's Prayer, Psalm 23, and The Beatitudes For People with Cancer
programme.desc: Ken visits fascinating sites in Israel, among them the location traditionally said to be where Jesus gave the Beatitudes. This collection of sayings about blessedness provided the opening to Jesus' Sermon on the Mount. Ken explores the richness and depth of the Beatitudes to challenge us to find blessedness out of our brokenness, a difficult task for those who are confronted with any life trauma
programme.sub-title: Reflections on The Beatitudes for People with Cancer

programme.title: John Bunyan: The Peoples Pilgrim
programme.desc: This documentary reveals the story of John Bunyan's life, his personal struggles, his triumphs, and his remarkable legacy.

programme.title: The Living Bible Series
programme.desc: The motive for Cain's crime is typically assumed to be jealousy, but the narrative never states this, nor does it provide a reason for God's rejection of his sacrifice.

programme.title: Biblical Collectors Series
programme.desc: Who was Mary Magdalene? A fallen woman rescued by Jesus or was she Christ's beloved disciple. An investigation into the mystery surrounding her identity produces startling insights. What message did the Virgin Mary bring to Fatima and reveal in 1917? A prophecy from biblical times? Learn the surprising answer.

programme.title: Remember the Goal
programme.desc: A young female coach fresh out of college takes over the cross country program at an all girls' Christian school and attempts to lead them to their first ever state title. As the runners begin to train, the top five girls all deal separately with particular issues relevant to teen life. As each of these stories unfold, so does the wisdom of the young coach as she guides the girls along the pathway of life

programme.title: Princess Cut
programme.desc: A lifelong Carolina farm girl, now in her early 20's, Grace has dreamed all her life of the day when "Mr. Right" slips a Princess Cut diamond on her finger and swears to love her forever. Tonight may be that night as Stewart has something special planned after 15 months together! But when things don't go as planned, and romance crashes down around her, it launches her on a quest, aided by her father, to understand what it means to truly love another person.

programme.title: The Secrets of Jonathan Sperry
programme.desc: Best buddies Dustin (Jansen Panettiere), Albert and Mark are twelve year old boys looking forward to a summer of fun in 1970. When Dustin mows the lawn of seventy-five year old Jonathan Sperry (Gavin MacLeod), a man he has seen at church, a unique friendship develops. What happens the rest of this summer is something Dustin and his friends will never forget!

programme.title: Unidentified
programme.desc: An incident occurs in a small Texas town. A man, while driving at night home on a back highway, claims to have encountered a UFO. Two reporters from a national magazine are sent to investigate; their editor wants to publish a story on the controversial subject of UFOs. Brad (Josh Adamson) thinks they're a hoax but Keith (Jonathan Aube) senses that something is out there. What follows is a quest by each man to prove the other wrong. Are UFOs real? A hoax? Is there an explanation?

programme.title: Time Changer
programme.desc: The year is 1890 and Bible Professor Russell Carlisle has written a manuscript and is set to receive an unanimous endorsement from the board at Grace Bible Seminary. Professor Carlisle's friend and colleague, Dr. Norris Anderson dissents, raising an objection. Using a secret time machine, Anderson sends Carlisle over 100 years into the future, offering him a glimpse of where his beliefs will lead.

programme.title: The Perfect Race
programme.desc: Allee-Sutton Hethcoat reprises her role as Coach Courtney Smith-Donnelly from 'Remember The Goal' in 'The Perfect Race'. She works with a female athlete at a small Christian college who tries to overcome long odds and win a national title in the 800 meter run. Coach Donnelly's training methods and teachings about life both line up with the concept that in order to win...you first have to lose.

programme.title: A Matter of Faith

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: After four weeks on the road Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lovers paradise and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.
programme.sub-title: Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated & is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birth place of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.
programme.sub-title: Go Greek! Clash of the Titans

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.
programme.sub-title: Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a Father and Son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the'Land Of Eternal Spring!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang- a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!
programme.sub-title: Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke is in the town of Hoi An. He visits a family who has been making chilli sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bomb shells.
programme.sub-title: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.
programme.sub-title: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke visits Huê- famous for its heritage and cuisine and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!
programme.sub-title: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delcious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!
programme.sub-title: Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delcious magenta sticky rice.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Nearing the end of his Vitenamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

programme.title: World's Most Incredible Hotels
programme.desc: We visit two hotels that have utilized their desert location in the United Arab Emirates to offer guests unique stays found in a few places in the world.

programme.title: World's Most Incredible Hotels
programme.desc: We visit the United Kingdom, a nation recognized for its rich history and classic regal elegance, and two hotels that embody the very best of these values despite very different locations.

programme.title: World's Most Incredible Hotels
programme.desc: In this episode, we visit Italy - the birthplace of western civilization and home to two incredible hotels set against some of this country's most stunning backdrops which embody the very best of their own regional history and culture.

programme.title: World's Most Incredible Hotels
programme.desc: Today we visit two hotels that use their stunning coastal locations, award-winning design, and friendly staff to charm their guests to create unforgettable once-in-a-lifetime experiences.

programme.title: World's Most Incredible Hotels
programme.desc: In this episode we're in the nation's capital of India - New Delhi and in 'The City of lakes' Udaipur at two Oberoi hotels where the standard of service takes hotel hospitality to a whole new level.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: On a mission to taste the worlds best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA boarder into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys

programme.title: Europe's Greatest Train Journeys
programme.desc: In Portugal, in the Douro River Valley, a steam locomotive and a small historic train will take you in turn to the water's edge, on the only railroad line in the world that crosses three World Heritage Sites classified by UNESCO.
